hypotheses: Do not treat a simple EMA9 or VWAP cross as sufficient confirmation.
Test joint EMA9 + session VWAP confirmation in the direction allowed by H1/M5 structure.
Reject or downgrade entries when the next support/resistance obstacle leaves insufficient reward relative to risk.
Use WAIT when H1/M5 are contradictory, price is chopping around EMA9/VWAP, confirmation is incomplete, or the entry is too close to an opposing level.
Test whether impulse volume improves discrimination of valid breaks/reclaims versus false starts.

long: M5 bullish structure or confirmed structural recovery
price reclaims and holds EMA9 and session VWAP
next resistance provides sufficient room in R
volume confirmation tested as an optional filter
short: M5 bearish structure or confirmed structural breakdown
price loses and holds below EMA9 and session VWAP
next support provides sufficient room in R
volume confirmation tested as an optional filter
wait: H1 and M5 conflict without structural confirmation
price repeatedly crosses EMA9/VWAP without follow-through
break is only a wick or lacks hold/retest confirmation

backtestPlan.rule: Do not promote globally. Keep only per-market variants that improve robustness without materially degrading drawdown or sample quality.

origin.note: TradingView observation: M5 price reclaimed EMA9 and session VWAP during a rebound, failed below nearby resistance, then lost EMA9/VWAP and returned toward support. This is a hypothesis-generating observation only, not statistical validation.
